tickerText: [TENNIS] Osaka beats Fernandez 6-4, 6-4 in Toronto as Rybakina rallies past Samsonova; Shelton tops Fonseca 6-3, 7-6(3) to reach Montreal QFs with all eight quarterfinalists aged 25 or under • [SQUASH] PSA tour prize money hits record $13.5M for 2025–26 season; PSA Valencia Memorial Chimo Marmaneu opens August 11 in Spain • [BADMINTON] Tee Kai Wun and Yap Roy King claim Korea Masters men's doubles title 21-13, 21-18 over compatriots Man Wei Chong and Soh Wooi Yik in all-Malaysia final • [PICKLEBALL] Carvana PPA Tour unveils World Pickleball Rankings and "BE THE BEST." rallying cry for unified global leaderboard in 2026–27 season • [TABLE TENNIS] Miwa and Tomokazu Harimoto both win WTT Champions Yokohama singles — sister beats Chen Xingtong 4-2, brother defends crown 4-1 over Oh Jun-seong

newsItems.title: Shelton Into Montreal QFs
newsItems.excerpt: Defending champion Ben Shelton beat João Fonseca 6-3, 7-6(3) at the National Bank Open in Montreal, joining an all-under-25 quarterfinal field.

newsItems.title: PSA Prize Money Record
newsItems.excerpt: The PSA Squash Tour distributed a record $13.5 million in prize money during the 2025–26 season, an 8% increase with 1,297 sanctioned events worldwide.

newsItems.title: World Pickleball Rankings Launch
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour debuts a unified World Pickleball Rankings system for 2026–27, combining results across singles, doubles, and mixed doubles on one global leaderboard.

newsItems.title: Harimoto Siblings Sweep Yokohama
newsItems.excerpt: Miwa and Tomokazu Harimoto both won WTT Champions Yokohama singles titles — Miwa beat Chen Xingtong 4-2 and Tomokazu defended his crown 4-1 over Oh Jun-seong.
